builds.base: origin/main e6520a21 plus the strmap_insert_plain Callgrind arm
builds.head1: the dispatch split: plain insert/remove lose the deferred test; shared call sites call insert_deferred/remove_deferred
builds.head2: head1 plus #[inline(always)] on ExpanseStrMap::insert and remove
builds.head3: head2 plus ExpanseOrderedBytesMap::insert computing the encoded key in its own body (one call site for the inlined insert)

what: Callgrind instruction counts (Ir) of every arm of the expanse-trie Callgrind harnesses (instructions, smoke_instructions, rmw_instructions, search_instructions, leaf_cap_cascaded) and the expanse-capi smoke_instructions harness, for four builds in one container image on one host

host.cpu: Intel Xeon E5-2697 v4 @ 2.30GHz, 2 sockets, 72 threads
host.os: Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS host, Linux 5.15; benches run in a Debian 13.7 container
host.role: x86_64 heavy-jobs host; not the reference benchmark host. Callgrind counts are deterministic; absolute counts differ from the CI instruction-counts job (Ubuntu 24.04, valgrind 3.27.1) through libc and valgrind version, so only deltas between these builds are compared

estimators.instructions: Callgrind Ir per arm as printed by iai-callgrind, exact; deterministic, so no interval and no rounds (AGENTS.md section 8.4)

commands: git archive <commit> | tar -x (tracked files only; no target, no .git); every file under crates/ touched before each build so cargo rebuilds from the archive

attribution: callgrind_annotate --inclusive=no --threshold=100 on each build's callgrind.<arm>.out; per-instruction: IAI_CALLGRIND_CALLGRIND_ARGS=--dump-instr=yes on base and head1, self Ir per address joined with objdump
provenance.build_isolation: one CARGO_TARGET_DIR shared by the builds, run one after another; the base binary rebuilt from the archive after head1 is byte-identical to the first base build
provenance.not_run: expanse-capi vs_stock (needs the stock libjudy oracle)

load.note: one-minute load average after each harness, in harness order; recorded for completeness, Callgrind counts do not depend on load

disassembly.command: objdump -d -C --no-show-raw-insn <instructions bench binary>; instructions and '%fs:' operands counted per function symbol (null: no out-of-line symbol). insert_deferred, remove_deferred and the head2 closure carry a .llvm.<hash> suffix that objdump does not demangle and are matched by their mangled names
disassembly.note: in head2 and head3 the binary carries no strmap_insert_plain wrapper symbol, and both arms measure 42,608,730; the two wrappers are taken to have been folded into one (inferred from the absent symbol and the equal counts, not verified further)

attribution.command: callgrind_annotate --inclusive=no --threshold=100, build minus base, per function (self Ir)

head1_per_instruction.what: self Ir of ExpanseStrMap::insert on strmap_insert/routes, per executed instruction (--dump-instr=yes), summed by mnemonic and by basic-block execution count
head1_per_instruction.by_block: chunk loop (193,748 executions): 19 -> 20 instructions, one register copy (mov %rbx,%r9) added; terminal-chunk block (49,503 executions): 9 -> 13, two register copies, one more and a reload of a static's address from the GOT that base kept in a register; a 40,625-execution block: 15 -> 19; blocks executed 50,000, 46,875, 43,750, 31,250 and 15,625 times lose 1 or 2 instructions each, the 50,000 one including the deferred test (mov/test/je)
head1_per_instruction.cause: register allocation in the out-of-line plain body differs once the shared twin is gone; Dr (data reads) in insert fell 422,337 while Ir rose 304,347

verdict.head1: G1 FAIL (+0.5870% against <= -0.34%); P FAIL on 14 plain arms (worst strmap_raw_insert/clean +0.6511%); S, N, C met
verdict.head2: G1 met (-1.6554%); G2 met, read on the arm total (-5.0232%); P FAIL on ordered_bytesmap_insert/clean +1.0836% and /escaped +0.8055%; S, N, C met
verdict.head3: G1 met (-1.6554%); G2 met, read on the arm total (-5.0232%), since remove is inlined and leaves no call record; P met (every plain string arm falls, -0.3825% to -5.0232%); S met (every sync_strmap arm identical); N met (every non-string arm identical); C met
